$comment: The public-surface gate's axes for @cosyte/mllp, read by `node node_modules/@cosyte/script-utils/internal-refs.js` (pnpm check:no-internal-refs). The rule set is the shared one in @cosyte/script-utils; this file adds mllp's own detection and never subtracts. Each extra rule is a pattern the shared rules lack, carried over from this repository's former scripts/check-no-internal-refs.sh with its self-test samples.

extraRules.name: internal project identifier (mllp's own item ids)
positives: CLIENT-04, SERVER-12, FRAME-11, LIFE-02, OBS-01, WARN-06, ERR-02, PLAN-06, SC-5, D-23, D-CR-01, W-07, B-05 and T-05-04-09 all track it
negatives: MSH-10 and MSA-2 and MSH-1 and MSH-2 and MSH-7 and MSH-9 and MSH-15 and MSH-18 and MSA-1 and MSA-3 and PID-3 and BTS-1 and the range MSH-3..6, the HL7 error segment fields ERR-3 and ERR-4, IHE ITI-19 and ITI TF-2, UTF-8 and UTF-16 and UTF-32 and ISO-8859-1, the internal branch names FRAME-FATAL and ACCEPT-SAFE and FAIL-SAFE and POST-BIND and PRE-ENCODE and SINGLE-FLIGHT and OS-NORMALIZED, MLLP-framed bytes and HL7-defined tables and TLS-terminated sockets, legacy SNOMED RT D-13000 and T-32000 and M-80003, ICD-10-CM P00-P96, FHIR-bridge stability, docs-content/ layout, HL7-V2 and HL7-CDA, FHIR-R4, DICOM-SR, X12-837P and X12-005010, NCPDP-SCRIPT

extraRules.name: plan language
negatives: a migration plan, the plan is to reconnect, and plans for TLS

extraRules.name: internal roadmap citation
positives: See the mllp roadmap, our roadmap, roadmap §4 and ROADMAP SC-5
negatives: A product roadmap, the vendor roadmap page, and a section simply headed Roadmap
